security.name: Qantas Airways
security.long_business_summary: Qantas Airways Limited provides air transportation services in Australia and internationally. The company operates through Qantas Domestic, Qantas International, Jetstar Group, and Qantas Loyalty segments. It offers cargo, passengers, and air freight services; and customer loyalty recognition programs. The company operates under the Qantas and Jetstar brands. Qantas Airways Limited was founded in 1920 and is headquartered in Mascot, Australia.

items.name: Stable Margins

items.reason: Cash flow from operations relative to net income — earnings backed by cash (low accruals) indicate conservative accounting.

items.name: Attractive Valuation
items.reason: Valuation multiples and yields versus the market, the sector, and the company's own historical range — cheaper relative to quality scores higher.
